findings.claim: The new project plan does not establish teach-before-apply on Fast Track FT15 within the fixed calendar. Its three S27 concepts are first taught on FT15, but the allocation places only 10 of 68 page minutes in the Skim block, leaves 58 page minutes outside every block, and separately assigns the unchanged project brief all 70 Project minutes. Therefore the assertion that the pages precede the project cannot be executed in FT15's fixed 120 minutes; it depends on 58 minutes outside the calendar. Standard S27 does establish action-level ordering inside Build, but Fast FT15 does not yet have an executable prerequisite-aligned sequence.

evidence.section: dayTypes.Fast and track day FT15: fixed 5/10/15/70/15/5 minute blocks and the seven FT15 topic rows

findings.recommendation: Reconcile a concrete FT15 sequence that teaches each of the three S27 concepts before its project step without exceeding the frozen 120-minute template. Preserve the canonical brief and syllabus; for example, explicitly interleave only the prerequisite instruction needed for each step inside the 70-minute Project block and size the reused brief to the resulting time, or obtain the required pacing decision before approval. Do not claim teach-before-apply while 58 prerequisite page minutes remain unallocated.

items.note: Objective o1 now accurately contrasts JavaScript's dynamic typing and Number and BigInt numeric primitives with Java's static numeric types.
Objective o1 now distinguishes restricting frontend JavaScript from reading a response from sending the request, and limits preflight to requests outside CORS-safelisted conditions.
The S23 JavaScript Fundamentals module lab was removed; the module and all seven topic manifests now consistently record no lab, matching the matrix-defined artifact scope.
The source snapshot now includes versioned official Node.js v22 documentation for node:test and global fetch with retrieval receipts and sections used.
Objective o1 now scopes visible labels to visible user-input controls and separately requires accessible names for controls without a label.
